description: This file contains functions for converting DOM elements to images or SVG data, including inlining fonts and images, creating canvases, and serializing SVGs. It is part of the Clipper module in the Notesnook project.

methods.name: getInlinedNode
methods.description: Clones a DOM node, optionally inlining fonts and images, and returns the modified clone.

methods.name: toPng
methods.description: Converts a DOM element to a PNG data URL.

methods.name: toJpeg
methods.description: Converts a DOM element to a JPEG data URL with specified quality.

methods.name: toBlob
methods.description: Converts a DOM element to a Blob object representing the image.

methods.name: toSvg
methods.description: Serializes a DOM element to an SVG string.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws a DOM element onto a canvas by rendering it as an SVG and then drawing the image.

methods.name: newCanvas
methods.description: Creates a new canvas element with specified scale and background color.

methods.name: embedFonts
methods.description: Embeds fonts into a DOM node by resolving all font-face rules and appending style.

methods.name: makeSvg
methods.description: Creates an SVG string from a DOM element, including styles and foreignObject.

methods.name: makeSvgDataUri
methods.description: Encodes an SVG string into a data URI.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Adjusts anchor hrefs in the DOM tree to be absolute URLs.
